scope: Three alternating before/after pairs using fresh databases. Baseline includes the earlier SQL and FUSE metadata-cache optimizations. Both variants use FULL WAL commits, direct file I/O and 60-second positive metadata caching. Other host workloads were active; agent-owned builds and tests did not overlap timed runs. No comparison server was rerun.

metadata.units: stat: operations/s; readdir: entries/s; macro workloads: seconds

reference_diagnostic.description: 64 warmed file open/read/close cycles, each followed by directory open/list/close; an FSYNCDIR request drains releases. Timings include strace and are excluded from performance comparisons. The reused runner labels this diagnostic metric stat in its raw output; it exercises references, not stat calls.

validation.regression_baseline: test_repeated_open_release_does_not_commit_existing_inode_references failed against 98b0fe44c6 (data_version changed 2 -> 3); passes with optimization

limitations: Shared host, three repetitions only; all samples are retained.
Optimized Git clone has a 13.238-second outlier; its other samples are 1.682 and 1.573 seconds. The cause of the outlier is not established.
Git diff improvement is small relative to variation. Hot stat remains served by the kernel cache.
Reference operations still serialize through BEGIN IMMEDIATE; first/last pins and content/namespace mutations remain durable. Sequential-write FULL commit cost is unchanged.
